svg.text: Iteration 05 - PROVISIONAL inner board boundary (ice-contact edge). Geometry version 0.2.0. Awaiting user visual review.
35e59e01c299fca695161760bcff1e7b8a9a79430a200fa1c4a50ecaeca8fea1. Embedded unchanged; drawn at native size (1 unit = 1 source pixel, u right, v down).
Magenta solid: detected edge (1431/1440 rays). Orange dashed: interpolated between neighbouring detected points where the edge is disturbed (2 segments; assumption
Blue circles: landmarks where markings meet the long boards; labels give ID and source-pixel coordinates.
The line is the ice-side edge of the near-black strip at the board base (assume.board_edge_is_ice_contact; strip median 14.75 px). NOT the board top rail, NOT the outer
housing, NOT the loose sheet perimeter (hidden under the boards).
Error estimate: trace uncertainty 21 px (ceil(median dark-strip width + 2 x worst straight-side RMS). The strip term dominates: the true contact line may lie anywhere
across the strip.). Straight-side fit RMS worst 2.732 px; corner radii 610.5 / 624.2 / 613 / 624.6 px.
Projection: opposite sides parallel within 0.2205 deg (top/bottom) and 0.0591 deg (left/right); width 2603.83 / 2610.19 / 2616.56 px at left/mid/right; outward bow up to
10.1 px (lens distortion or real board bow). Similarity-mapping bound 16.46 px.
Markings: centre line -9.11 px from the traced boundary centre along the long axis; every marking line leans -17.47 / -14.73 / -15.94 / -14.34 px (top minus bottom, along
the long axis) relative to the board normal: the printed sheet may sit slightly rotated in the boards.
PREVIEW SCALE (ASSUMED, not calibrated): 0.179597 mm/px uniform from catalog length approx. 845 mm = traced length 4704.99 px. Implied width 468.78 mm vs catalog approx.
457 mm (discrepancy 11.78 mm; aspect 1.8025 vs 1.849). No millimetre accuracy is claimed.
No plane rectification applied. Elevated objects (board tops, screens, figures, goals) are not mapped. Numbers: validation/05-board-report.json.
